articles.summary: SMB underwriting data is the structured and unstructured information—bank transactions, credit bureau records, accounting data, identity verification, and behavioral signals—that lenders use to assess whether a small or medium-sized business qualifies for financing. This data powers every core lending decision: who gets approved, at what terms, and how fast.
articles.title: SMB Underwriting Data: The Key to Scalable Lending Operations

articles.summary: Understanding where customers come from is essential for companies looking to scale efficiently. Businesses invest heavily across marketing channels, partnerships, email campaigns, embedded experiences, and referral networks, but without accurate tracking, it becomes difficult to know which efforts are actually driving results.
articles.title: Enhanced Metadata Tracking Now Available in Lendflow

articles.summary: As companies grow, their brands often evolve alongside them. Many organizations operate multiple brands under a single parent company to serve different audiences, enter new markets, test new products, or create more specialized customer experiences. In lending and embedded finance, that flexibility is especially important because each customer journey needs to feel tailored, relevant, and aligned with the audience it serves.
